verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party documentation of choosing a cloud provider or region for an account. The closest evidence is that Snowflake's Apache Iceberg tables store data in external cloud storage that the customer manages, which gives the customer some control over where data physically lives. A community user also mentions running a trial on "AWS US East", which implies region choice but documents it only in passing. missing for 10: first-party docs on account region/cloud selection, data residency guarantees or documented residency controls, cross-region replication/residency policy details, independent corroboration.
